import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, json
def p(x,y): return adsk.core.Point3D.create(x,y,0)
def rectangle(sk,x0,y0,x1,y1):
    ls=sk.sketchCurves.sketchLines
    ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x0,y0),p(x1,y0)); ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x1,y0),p(x1,y1)); ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x1,y1),p(x0,y1)); ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x0,y1),p(x0,y0))
def circle(sk,cx,cy,r):
    sk.sketchCurves.sketchCircles.addByCenterRadius(p(cx,cy),r)
def ext(root,sk,dist,op,name):
    f=root.features.extrudeFeatures.addSimple(sk.profiles.item(0),adsk.core.ValueInput.createByReal(dist),op); f.name=name; return f
def run(_context):
    app=adsk.core.Application.get()
    out=[]
    for i in range(app.documents.count):
        doc=app.documents.item(i)
        des=adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
        if not des: continue
        root=des.rootComponent
        target=None
        for b in root.bRepBodies:
            if b.name in ('LEFT_CASE_BOTTOM','RIGHT_TRACKBALL_CASE_BOTTOM'):
                target=b
        if not target: continue
        bb=target.boundingBox
        x0=bb.minPoint.x; x1=bb.maxPoint.x; y0=bb.minPoint.y; y1=bb.maxPoint.y
        ix0=x0+0.30; ix1=x1-0.30; iy0=y0+0.30; iy1=y1-0.30
        planeInput=root.constructionPlanes.createInput()
        planeInput.setByOffset(root.xYConstructionPlane,adsk.core.ValueInput.createByReal(1.07))
        plane=root.constructionPlanes.add(planeInput)
        s=root.sketches.add(plane); s.name=target.name+'_TOP_OUTER'; rectangle(s,x0,y0,x1,y1)
        ext(root,s,0.35,adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.NewBodyFeatureOperation,target.name.replace('_BOTTOM','_TOP'))
        s2=root.sketches.add(plane); s2.name=target.name+'_TOP_OPENING'; rectangle(s2,ix0,iy0,ix1,iy1)
        ext(root,s2,0.35,adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.CutFeatureOperation,target.name.replace('_BOTTOM','_TOP_OPENING'))
        if target.name.startswith('RIGHT'):
            cx=16.0995; cy=-11.4535; hole=1.85
            sh=root.sketches.add(plane); sh.name='RIGHT_TOP_TRACKBALL_OPENING'; circle(sh,cx,cy,hole)
            ext(root,sh,0.35,adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.CutFeatureOperation,'RIGHT_TOP_TRACKBALL_CUT')
        for sk in (s,s2):
            sk.isVisible=False
        if target.name.startswith('RIGHT'):
            sh.isVisible=False
        top=root.bRepBodies.item(root.bRepBodies.count-1)
        top.name=target.name.replace('_BOTTOM','_TOP')
        doc.activate()
        mgr=des.exportManager
        stl_path='/Users/daiki/Projects/sage60/mechanical/gasket_v1/'+('sage60_right_tb_case_top.stl' if target.name.startswith('RIGHT') else 'sage60_left_case_top.stl')
        step_path='/Users/daiki/Projects/sage60/mechanical/gasket_v1/'+('sage60_right_tb_case_complete.step' if target.name.startswith('RIGHT') else 'sage60_left_case_complete.step')
        ok1=mgr.execute(mgr.createSTLExportOptions(top,stl_path))
        ok2=mgr.execute(mgr.createSTEPExportOptions(step_path,root))
        out.append({'documentIndex':i,'bottom':target.name,'top':top.name,'topZmm':10.7,'topThicknessMm':3.5,'stl':bool(ok1),'completeStep':bool(ok2)})
    print(json.dumps(out))
